label: rem:co-triple-bond-energy
title: $CO$ triple bond energy from the Wedderburn invariants
html:
Remark. CO triple bond energy from the Wedderburn invariants

The CO bond energy decomposes into three Wedderburn channels:

  \mathfrak{E}_{\mathrm{bind}}(CO) = \alpha \sum_{i \in \mathrm{bonds}}
  \ln\lvert \hat{V}_i^{\mathrm{full}} \rvert

where the sum runs over all 6 covalent-channel generators (3 bonds \times 2 crossings each). The full traced volume includes symmetric, standard, and alternating representations:

  \hat{V}_i^{\mathrm{full}} =
  w_{\mathrm{sym}} \lambda_i^{\mathrm{sym}} +
  w_{\mathrm{std}} \hat{V}_i^{\mathrm{std}} +
  w_{\mathrm{alt}} \lambda_i^{\mathrm{alt}}

For the triple bond:

  • \sigma bond generators: eigenvalue products from the head-on overlap of 2s/2p_z orbitals.
  • \pi bond generators: eigenvalue products from lateral overlap of 2p_x and 2p_y orbitals.
  • The \sigma bond contributes the largest |\hat{V}| (strong overlap). The \pi bonds contribute smaller |\hat{V}| (weaker lateral overlap).

Provenance and scope (2026-08-25). The witness cited below, co-molecular-binding.witness.json, is absent from the tree — it was added 2026-04-13 in commit a3e8c2c82d under folio-assistant/computations/ and left with the platform code in the miga migration. Recovered and read (analysis), it does not support the surrounding text:

  • Its energy scale is fitted. calibration_factor = 0.23879110765149733 is exactly 4.478 / 18.753, the ratio that makes the uncalibrated result equal \mathrm{H}_2's measured bond energy — a fourth calibration, on a molecular observable, outside CAL-1/2/3. The owner directive of 2026-08-25 is no fitting, so the resulting number is not admissible as a parameter-free prediction.
  • Its three bonds are not differentiated. The text below says the \sigma bond contributes the largest \lvert\hat{V}\rvert and the \pi bonds smaller; in the witness all three carry the identical \Delta\Phi_1 = 0.687012518457808, and the k=3 total is exactly three times the k=1 value.
  • It records no LP duals. The list below claims shadow prices y_1, y_2, y_3; y0_star, y_star, active_set, primal_obj, dual_obj and duality_gap are all absent.

Its own surviving assertion is "CO triple bond within 25 % of observed" against D_0(\mathrm{CO}) = 11.09 eV; the computed 13.434 eV is +21.1\% — inside a loose bar, reached via a scale fitted on a different molecule. Do not cite this bond energy as derived.

The computation requires assembling the 42-strand transfer matrix chain. We perform this iteratively, reducing to NF at each step. The witness file co-molecular-binding.witness.json records:

  • \Phi_1 for isolated C and O atoms.
  • \Phi_1 for the CO molecular braid at each bond order k = 1, 2, 3.
  • The LP dual shadow prices y_1, y_2, y_3.
  • Comparison with observed D_0 \approx 11.09\;\text{eV} \;\mathrm{eV}.
